question: What understanding has been gained through the grace of the lord of Kaulas?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of Kaulas
Knowledge arose by that lord's grace
The object known is the determination of Kaula
inference: By the lord's grace, the speaker has understood the Kaula doctrine.
plain_english: O Lord of the Kaulas, by your grace I have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching.
